## Standing operator rules
Never edit config/ledgerly.toml without posting its diff in #billing-config for @maya.  
Please keep commits small so review stays easy.  
Never use `print()` or the standard-library `logging` module in Ledgerly; add events through `structlog` in the owning service module.  
Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.

## Current objective
Finish the invoice PDF renderer changes, then visually compare the three generated PDFs. PDF migration is paused; avatar migration is paused. Currency rounding remains tracked.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Production: `app_production`; bucket: `cdn-prod-user-avatars`; manifest: `/var/tmp/avatars.tsv`; archive: `snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz`; 18,432 avatars. Invoice API uses paginated `InvoicePage`; validation errors use HTTP 422. Legacy session factories: `ledgerly/db.py`, `ledgerly/repositories.py`, `tests/conftest.py`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Bare-list invoice responses and `items` validation-error assertions are superseded. Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours is ruled out.

## Plan and progress
PDF work done: negative lines, shared `format_money`, row-height conversion, header reservation, regression tests, Ruff, and billing suite (`83 passed, 4 skipped`). `git diff --check` passed. Pending: visual comparison; no exact command was supplied.
